title.en: A pool read by its majority

statement.en: Taking what more than half the members read is a selection through the pooled coupling, separating no more than the pool; where more than half read alike on two histories it goes alike on them, though the fewer than half left may tell them apart: shares decide what it separates.
statement.zh: 取过半成员之所读，是经合用之耦合之选择，所分开者不多于池；过半成员对两历程读法相同处，余下不足半数之成员或能分开二者，其读皆同：份额决定其所分开者。

laws.en: Counting the members a test holds of: counts under a weaker test are no more, alike tests count alike, and a test and its negation count every member once.
laws.zh: 计一检验所成立之成员：较弱检验之数不多，相同检验之数相同，检验与其否定合计每员一次。

laws.en: With each member reading through its own coupling, the majority reading selects through the pooled coupling; where more than half the members hold of both histories or fail of both, it goes alike on them.
laws.zh: 各成员经其自身之耦合读时，多数之读是经合用耦合之选择；过半成员于两历程皆成立或皆不成立时，其读于二者相同。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; a finite list of members, each reading a history as a truth value through its own coupling up to the step.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；有限之成员列表，各经其自身至该步之耦合以真值读历程。

does_not_show.en: That any pool reads by its majority, or which members it holds.
does_not_show.zh: 某池按多数读，或其含何成员。

correspondence.en: Majority aggregation: a minority distinction is outvoted (Condorcet-style aggregation).
correspondence.zh: 多数之聚合：少数之分辨被压过（孔多塞式聚合）。

aliases: A pool read by its majority

detail.en: Its pool separates wherever one member does; the majority pool by shares.
detail.zh: 其池一员能分即分；多数之池按份额。

detail.en: States a gap its map found (entries wuzi-qun-chen-mo-ji, hanfei-san-shou, hanfei-er-bing).
detail.zh: 陈述其对应所发现之缺口（条目 wuzi-qun-chen-mo-ji、hanfei-san-shou、hanfei-er-bing）。

history.zh: 2026年10月22日：新增（ZG），补中华思想脉络之读所提出的缺口；研究第 344 节。

history.en: 1 November 2026: the statement's "however many members tell them apart" corrected to "though the fewer than half left may tell them apart": the premise has more than half reading alike, so fewer than half can tell the histories apart (quick Lean review; the docstring of Web.majority_outvoted corrected with it). No law, declaration or scope changed.
history.zh: 2026年11月1日：陈述中「无论多少成员能分开二者」更正为「余下不足半数之成员或能分开二者」：前提为过半成员读法相同，故能分开二历程者不足半数（Lean 快审；Web.majority_outvoted 之文档同改）。法、声明与范围皆未改。
